title: log-unknown-blob-storage-attr
request: hey, when I try to access a missing attribute from langfuse.api.blob_storage_integrations.types it just raises an AttributeError. can we log a warning before raising so we have a trace in logs?

--- a/langfuse/api/blob_storage_integrations/types/__init__.py

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@

 # isort: skip_file
+import logging
 
 import typing
 from importlib import import_module
@@ -47,6 +48,12 @@
 def __getattr__(attr_name: str) -> typing.Any:
     module_name = _dynamic_imports.get(attr_name)
     if module_name is None:
+        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+        logger.warning(
+            "Attempted to access unknown attribute %s in %s",
+            attr_name,
+            __name__,
+        )
         raise AttributeError(
             f"No {attr_name} found in _dynamic_imports for module name -> {__name__}"
         )
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_blob_storage_imports_logging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import importlib
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_missing_attribute_logs_warning(caplog):
+    module = importlib.import_module(
+        "langfuse.api.blob_storage_integrations.types"
+    )
+    missing_attr = "NonExistentAttribute"
+    with caplog.at_level("WARNING"):
+        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+            getattr(module, missing_attr)
+    # Verify that a warning was logged mentioning the missing attribute
+    warning_messages = [rec.message for rec in caplog.records if rec.levelname == "WARNING"]
+    assert any(
+        missing_attr in msg and "Attempted to access unknown attribute" in msg
+        for msg in warning_messages
+    )
